headline: Morocco: SanlamAllianz and CloudFret launch insurance covering carriers and their goods
summary: SanlamAllianz Maroc and digital platform CloudFret signed a partnership on 17 November 2026 to develop insurance for road transport professionals. The offer will cover vehicles, transported goods and carriers' health.
why: SanlamAllianz is a pan-African insurance group, and partnerships like this extend its insurance coverage into logistics and transport segments.
original_headline: Maroc : SanlamAllianz et CloudFret lancent une assurance couvrant les transporteurs et leurs marchandises
